column1: Check for proper fastening to floor (cinch anchors).
Check for proper assembly of switchgear including all bus ties installed and torqued.  Mark each torqued joint.

Check if switchgear is completely wired according to manufacturer’s and Chemetics’ drawings:
incoming feeder(s): correct cable size, terminations and connectors
outgoing feeders: correct cable size, terminations and connectors
all control cables: correct cable sizes, terminations and connectors
Check all protection devices mounted, wired and adjusted.
Check complete switchgear for missing cover plates.
Check if switchgear is cleaned out and free of foreign matter.
